name: nwp_radar
title: NWP Radar Profile
description: Service profile for DGIWG NWP radar data, providing precipitation amount via OGC API - EDR. Supports cube, radius, and items queries with GET and POST.

contact.address: Ministry of Defence, Kommunikation, Rossauer Lände 1

collections.title: NWP Radar Collection
collections.description: NWP Radar Observations providing precipitation information. Datetime values use RFC 3339 format in Zulu Gregorian time (e.g. 2026-04-12T21:20:50Z).

unit.label: Precipitation amount of water in all phases: kilograms per metres squared.

observedProperty.label: Precipitation amount of water in all phases

requirements.statement: The coordinates for the bounding box SHALL be defined in the CRS EPSG:4326 (WGS84) with geographical latitude, then longitude, in decimal degrees.
parts: The service bbox SHALL have a geometry defined in WGS84.
The service bounding box coordinates SHALL be returned with geographical latitude, then longitude.
The service bounding box coordinates SHALL be returned in decimal degrees.

requirements.statement: The coordinates for the 2D bounding box SHALL be defined in the CRS84 EPSG:4326 (WGS84) for the extent [-180, -90, 180, 90].
parts: The 2D bounding box boundary SHALL be for the extent [-180, -90, 180, 90].
The coordinate reference system for the bounding box SHALL be EPSG:4326 (WGS84).

requirements.statement: Temporal Reference System (trs) values SHALL be presented in Gregorian calendar Zulu datetime (UTC) in 24 hour clock with a precision to the second according to the time format specified in RFC 3339.
parts: The service trs SHALL be in Gregorian calendar Zulu datetime (UTC) in 24 hour clock with a precision to the second.
The service trs SHALL be the time format specified in RFC 3339.

requirements.statement: Vertical Reference System (vrs) values SHALL be height in metres.
parts: The service vrs SHALL be in height metres.
The service vrs SHALL be EPSG:3855.
The service vrs SHALL use the vertical datum EGM2008 geoid as the zero-height reference (orthometric height relative to mean sea level).

requirements.statement: The following keywords SHALL be included in the collection response: "cube", "radius", "items", "precipitation_amount", "radar".
parts: The collection keywords array SHALL include "cube", "radius", and "items".
The collection keywords array SHALL include "precipitation_amount" and "radar".

requirements.statement: All links objects SHALL have href, rel, title and type attributes.
parts: Each link object SHALL include a non-empty href attribute.
Each link object SHALL include rel, title and type attributes.

requirements.statement: The following data queries SHALL be supported: "cube", "items", "radius".
parts: The collection SHALL advertise cube, items and radius data queries.

requirements.statement: The service SHALL provide a /collections/nwp_radar_precipitation/items endpoint.
parts: The service SHALL return CoverageJSON FeatureCollection and GRIB2, GeoTIFF, HDF5, NetCDF4, PNG file formats.
The service SHALL return a default file format of GeoTIFF.
Each feature SHALL include precipitation_amount property.
Each feature SHALL include datetime property in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ e.g. 2026-04-12T21:20:50.52Z.
The items data queries SHALL return CoverageJSON that complies with the OGC CoverageJSON standard - https://docs.ogc.org/cs/21-069r2/21-069r2.html#_df6ce66a-7369-49cb-b59f-47a8c5d424ca
The items data queries SHALL return GeoTIFF which complies with the DGIWG 108 GeoTIFF for GeoRef Imagery Standard.
The items data queries SHALL return GRIB2 which complies with the WMO Manual On Codes - https://library.wmo.int/records/item/35625-manual-on-codes-volume-i-2-international-codes.
The items data queries SHALL return HDF5 which complies with the CF-NetCDF v1.13 conventions - https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html.
The items data queries SHALL return NetCDF4 which complies with the CF-NetCDF v1.13 conventions - https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html.

requirements.statement: The service SHALL provide a /collections/nwp_radar_precipitation/cube endpoint.
parts: The service SHALL return CoverageJSON FeatureCollection and GRIB2, GeoTIFF, HDF5, NetCDF4, PNG file formats.
The service SHALL return a default file format of GeoTIFF.
Each feature SHALL include precipitation_amount property.
Each feature SHALL include datetime property in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ e.g. 2026-04-12T21:20:50.52Z.
The cube data queries SHALL return CoverageJSON that complies with the OGC CoverageJSON standard - https://docs.ogc.org/cs/21-069r2/21-069r2.html#_df6ce66a-7369-49cb-b59f-47a8c5d424ca
The cube data queries SHALL return GeoTIFF which complies with the DGIWG 108 GeoTIFF for GeoRef Imagery Standard.
The cube data queries SHALL return GRIB2 which complies with the WMO Manual On Codes - https://library.wmo.int/records/item/35625-manual-on-codes-volume-i-2-international-codes.
The cube data queries SHALL return HDF5 which complies with the CF-NetCDF v1.13 conventions - https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html.
The cube data queries SHALL return NetCDF4 which complies with the CF-NetCDF v1.13 conventions - https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html.

requirements.statement: The service SHALL provide a /collections/nwp_radar_precipitation/radius endpoint.
parts: The service SHALL return CoverageJSON FeatureCollection and GRIB2, GeoTIFF, HDF5, NetCDF4, PNG file formats.
The service SHALL return a default file format of GeoTIFF.
Each feature SHALL include precipitation_amount property.
Each feature SHALL include datetime property in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ e.g. 2026-04-12T21:20:50.52Z.
The radius data queries SHALL return CoverageJSON that complies with the OGC CoverageJSON standard - https://docs.ogc.org/cs/21-069r2/21-069r2.html#_df6ce66a-7369-49cb-b59f-47a8c5d424ca
The radius data queries SHALL return GeoTIFF which complies with the DGIWG 108 GeoTIFF for GeoRef Imagery Standard.
The radius data queries SHALL return GRIB2 which complies with the WMO Manual On Codes - https://library.wmo.int/records/item/35625-manual-on-codes-volume-i-2-international-codes.
The radius data queries SHALL return HDF5 which complies with the CF-NetCDF v1.13 conventions - https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html.
The radius data queries SHALL return NetCDF4 which complies with the CF-NetCDF v1.13 conventions - https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.13/cf-conventions.html.

requirements.statement: The following parameters SHALL be supported: datetime, precipitation_amount.
parts: The parameter datetime SHALL be in Gregorian calendar Zulu datetime (UTC) in 24 hour clock with a precision to the second.
The parameter datetime SHALL be the time format specified in RFC 3339.
The parameter precipitation_amount SHALL return values in kg m-2 units.

requirements.statement: The service SHALL be configured to return data for both GET and POST HTTP Method Requests.
parts: The service SHALL support both GET and POST HTTP Methods for queries.
